about: TinyCLIP 39M/16 vectors for the world tuning, test and casual photos (lab/world-eval on pub/data-world): the original model's on every row, and the shipping int8 file through onnxruntime-web's WASM build on the tuning and test rows (split eval), as the phone computes them. Publishes after run 36 (world-fit) so that the two never race.
